title: Streaks + lightweight gamification
description:
Surface a small streak indicator for daily visits and a weekly "your week on Bluesky" recap (posts, new followers, top-engagement post). Proven retention lever from Snapchat/Duolingo.

v0 product decisions (normative)

- Visit definition: foregrounded ≥30s with ≥1 feed item rendered (signed in).
- Day boundary: device-local midnight-to-midnight (IANA tz).
- Break rule: one missed day = silent grace; two missed days = reset to 0.
- Placement: native home header near drawer avatar; web left-rail under profile row. Home tab only.
- Recap delivery: in-app card pinned to Notifications tab + full-screen Recap route. No push, no email, no widget.
- Recap cadence: Monday ≥06:00 device-local for prior ISO week (Mon–Sun). 7-day auto-expiry.
- Opt-in posture: default ON for both surfaces (single Settings → Activity & recap screen).
- Storage: client-local only. No new lexicon, no PDS record.

Out of scope for v0
Streak freezes / purchases / restoration; sharing; leaderboards + friend streaks; badges/trophies/levels/XP; push + email for recap; server-side record / new lexicon / PDS persistence; metrics beyond the 3 specified; streak on tabs other than Home; cross-device sync; editorial content in recap.

KPIs
K1 D7 retention lift ≥1.5% (holdout vs. exposed) without uninstall increase over 60d.
K2 Recap card CTR ≥20%.
K3 Opt-out rate <10% at 14 days per surface (guardrail).

Architecture recommendations

- Streak: client-local, account-scoped MMKV. Extend Account schema with StreakStore {lastVisitDay, lastVisitZone, currentStreak, longestStreak, lastVisitAt}. Device IANA tz is the day anchor (not UTC, not profile-declared) so travel/DST don't destroy streaks. Cross-device reconciliation is best-effort (last-write-wins + same-day max) via compact NUX blob.
- Recap: client-computed via TanStack Query key ['weeklyRecap', {did, weekIso}], staleTime 1h, persistedVersion 1. getAuthorFeed capped at 6 pages, short-circuit on indexedAt<windowStart. Follower delta from daily snapshot ring buffer (atproto has no per-edge timestamp — precise "new followers" NOT achievable in v0).
- Recap trigger: foreground AppState poll + once-per-week auto-open dialog. No push. expo-notifications not in the codebase.

Top 3 technical risks
R1 Timezone / DST silently breaking streaks.
R2 Followers-delta inaccuracy (no atproto edge timestamps).
R3 getAuthorFeed pagination cost for prolific posters.

Guardrails (humane-first)
G1 No loss-aversion: no countdowns, no "about to break" warnings, no push.
G2 Silent grace day; no "you saved your streak!" celebration loop.
G3 Low visual weight: flame + small integer; no animation/haptic/sound on increment.
G4 Hidden below day 2.
G5 No social pressure: no leaderboards, no friend streaks, no share.
G6 No passive-engagement metrics (no time-spent, no scrolls).
G7 No re-engagement for churned users: 0-visit week produces no recap.
G8 Default-on with prominent opt-out (1 screen deep + in-sheet link).
G9 Client-local only — fully reversible without protocol debris.
G10 Opt-out is permanent: never re-prompt to re-enable.

Open product questions (pre-GA, non-blocking for spec)
Q1 Visit threshold: 30s + feed render vs. simpler "any foreground"?
Q2 Web placement: left rail vs. top header.
Q3 Top-post tiebreaker: newer or older? (draft assumes newer)
Q4 Posts count: combined vs. split (posts / replies / reposts)?
Q5 KPI holdout feasibility (10% for 60 days).
Q6 Opt-in vs. opt-out default — draft says opt-out; leadership to confirm given Bluesky ethos.
Q7 "Past recaps" retention window (draft: 4 weeks).
Q8 Analytics pipeline approved for recap booleans?
Q9 Rename "streak" to something less dark-pattern-coded (e.g. "daily visits")?

Specs persisted on the agent

- .claude/state/i9KLo7kw/ac_product.md
- .claude/state/i9KLo7kw/ux_design.md
- .claude/state/i9KLo7kw/arch_plan.md
acceptance_criteria: A1 Qualifying visit = ≥30s foregrounded + ≥1 feed render; same-day dups do not increment.
A2 Consecutive-day increment by exactly 1; persists across restarts.
A3 Silent grace day: one missed day forgiven; grace only visible in explainer sheet.
A4 Reset to 1 after ≥2 consecutive missed days.
A5 Anti-manipulation: tz change never decreases; max 1 increment per 20 wall-clock hrs (UTC monotonic guard).
A6 Placement + accessibilityLabel "{n}-day Bluesky streak"; testID=streakIndicator; Home tab only.
A7 Hidden when logged out, opted out, or streak < 2.
A8 Tap opens Dialog with current + longest + rules + grace + Settings link. No share CTA.
A9 Persisted storage only; no network request carries streak data.
A10 Per-DID; account switch swaps; account removal clears.
B1 Monday ≥06:00 local if ≥1 qualifying visit in prior ISO week.
B2 Three metrics: posts authored, net new followers, top post (likes+reposts+replies).
B3 Tap card → full-screen Recap route embedding top post via existing post components.
B4 Zero-posts empty copy: "No posts this week — that's fine." No "post more" nudge. Negative follower delta clamped to 0.
B5 Dismissible; 4-week rolling "Past recaps" in Settings.
B6 Auto-expires after 7 days.
B7 No push / email / OS widget.
B8 Fetched via getAuthorFeed + getProfile for own DID; manual Retry; auto-retry capped at 2/hr.
B9 Renders under RTL, long strings, screen reader, reduced-motion, large text.
B10 Moderation fallback: deleted/hidden top post → next-highest; none → empty copy.
B11 "Show weekly recap" OFF prevents computation entirely.
B12 Client-only compute; analytics carry booleans only.
X1 Settings → Activity & recap sub-screen, both toggles ON by default, <1s to take effect, no restart.
X2 Toggles persist per-account locally; no atproto prefs sync in v0.
X3 No NUX / modal / interstitial on first install.
X4 No numerical badges on app icon / tab bar / drawer.
X5 Lingui-wrapped strings, no hardcoded English.
X6 Feature-flaggable via existing gating to disable remotely without release.
